# External Derived Tables

Place `nmed_window_level_data.csv` here when running this extension locally. It is a derived table produced by the main Music Cognition EEG Pipeline output:

```text
full_v1_outputs/window_level_data.csv
```

It contains 5 s NMED-E EEG beta and engagement windows. It is not raw EEG.

This file is intentionally not included in the public repository. Regenerate it from the main pipeline or copy it from a local derived output before running the full experiment.
